issue.title: Add a web dashboard that draws the tree
issue.body:
## Problem

I would like to see the result of `flattenTree` as a picture instead of a list.

## Proposal

Ship a small web page with the library that draws the tree as an interactive diagram, with zoom, a dark theme and a button that exports a PNG.

## Acceptance

- The page opens in a browser and shows the tree.
